title: HAXcms plugin registry (_config/plugins/plugins.yaml)
description: What one scope (the system, or one site) has enabled, and the deployment's locks and blocks (spec/03, The plugin registry). Written by core when a plugin is enabled or disabled; read at load.

enabled.description: Plugin ids enabled in this scope. Required and locked plugins are on without being listed.

locked.description: System scope only: enabled and cannot be turned off, here or in any site.

blocked.description: System scope only: cannot be enabled anywhere in this deployment.

version.description: The plugin version that was enabled.

enabledAt.description: ISO 8601 time of the last enable.

by.description: User name of whoever enabled it.
